description: Observation vector layout per junction for AEGIS live inference & training.

_metadata.description: Frozen observation vector definition per junction for the AEGIS traffic control project.

lane_queues.description: Normalized queue length per inbound lane (0.0 = empty, 1.0 = at capacity).

missing_masks.description: True if the camera/sensor is down for that lane; the agent must impute or act conservatively.

observation_ages_s.description: Seconds since the last valid observation was received for each lane.

current_phase_onehot.description: One-hot encoding of the current green phase (exactly one element is 1).

elapsed_phase_s.description: Seconds elapsed in the current green phase.

neighbor_inflow.description: Estimated inflow rate from each neighboring junction (vehicles per decision interval).

junction_id_onehot.description: One-hot encoding identifying which junction this observation belongs to (J1–J4).
